summary: Fastcall getter that returns the dword at a1 + 4*a2 + 216: an indexed field read on the object a1 using a2 as a dword-array index with a fixed base offset of 216 bytes. Returns 0 when the object pointer a1 is null.

operations.description: Initialize result to 0; this default is returned when the object pointer a1 is null.
Guard on a1 being nonzero: when a1 is null the function returns the default result 0 without dereferencing.
Return the dword at a1 + 4*a2 + 216, i.e. the element a2 (dword stride) of a field array located 216 bytes into the object a1.

unresolved: Owner struct type is unknown; the indexed dword field at base offset 216 with a2 as a dword index depends on the caller's array layout. Callers cluster around scoring and championship aggregation.
